name: Folterbank
look: a long rectangular wooden frame lying flat on the ground, an iron roller drum at each short end, coiled ropes and rusty chains stretched along its length, the whole rectangle fully visible

name: Streckbett
look: a narrow rectangular wooden bench lying flat, an iron winch drum at the head end, leather straps at the four corners, planks running lengthwise

name: Blutopfer-Altar
look: a wide rectangular stone slab lying flat, dark dried blood pooled in a carved gutter around the rim, four burning candles standing at the corners

name: Runenstein
look: from straight above only the flat top face of the upright weathered granite monolith is visible, a rough rounded slab, glowing blue runes carved into the stone, moss in the cracks

name: Hexenkessel über Feuer
en: black iron cauldron over a fire
look: a round black iron cauldron centred, its circular rim and dark bubbling liquid filling the middle, burning logs and glowing orange embers arranged in a ring around the base

name: Skelett am Boden
en: human skeleton lying on the ground
look: a complete human skeleton lying flat on its back, skull at one end, ribcage, arms and legs spread out, tattered grey rags beneath the bones

name: Juwelentruhe
look: a rectangular wooden chest with iron bands, the lid folded wide open and lying flat, gold coins, jewels and a necklace spilling over the front edge

name: Waffenständer
look: a long low wooden rack, swords, axes and spears lying parallel in their slots side by side, the whole rack a narrow rectangle

name: Katapult
look: a square timber frame with four wheels at the corners, the throwing arm lying along the centre line, the bucket at one end, twisted rope bundles at the pivot

name: Rammbock
look: a long tree trunk with an iron ram head at one end, slung by chains inside a narrow wheeled wooden frame, forming a long rectangle

name: Bärenfalle
look: an open bear trap lying flat, two circular serrated jaws spread wide apart, the flat pressure plate in the middle, a short chain coiled to one side

name: Bodenleuchter
look: a round iron base with arms radiating out symmetrically like a star, a lit candle with a bright flame at the tip of every arm, wax dripping down

name: Eiserne Jungfrau
look: from straight above only the rounded rusty iron lid of the closed upright sarcophagus is visible, riveted seams, a hinge line down the middle, a small barred slot near the top

name: Galgen
look: from straight above a square stone base plate, the thick upright post as a small square in its middle, the horizontal beam crossing over it, a rope ending in a round noose

name: Pranger
look: a low stone platform with a horizontal wooden plank across it, three round holes cut for a head and two hands, iron hinges and a padlock at the side

name: Aufgeschlagenes Zauberbuch
look: an open leather book lying flat with two written glowing pages and a ribbon marker, the slanted wooden lectern top just visible as a frame around it

name: Kristallkugel
en: crystal ball on a bronze stand
look: straight from above only the bright glass sphere is visible as a perfect circle in the middle, four curved ornate bronze claws reaching inwards from a round base ring around it

name: Alchemietisch
look: a rectangular wooden table top, glass flasks, a retort, corked bottles, a mortar and an open book standing on it, the table edges forming a clean rectangle

name: Goldhaufen
en: pile of gold coins and treasure
look: a loose roughly circular heap of gold coins spread on the ground, gemstones, a goblet and a necklace scattered among them, coins thinning out at the edge

name: Rüstungsständer
en: suit of plate armour on a stand
look: from straight above the domed helmet top and the two shoulder plates form the widest shape, gauntleted arms hanging down at both sides, a round wooden base ring underneath

name: Blutverschmierter Steinboden
look: worn grey flagstones of different sizes, dark dried blood smeared across them and soaked into the joints, a few fresh red drops

name: Runenboden
look: polished dark slate slabs engraved with concentric circles and angular runes, the carved lines filled with faint pale blue light

name: Knochenboden
look: dry brown dirt densely littered with bleached bones, ribs, vertebrae and half buried skulls, dust between them

name: Lavarisse
look: a black basalt crust broken by a web of narrow glowing orange and yellow lava veins, fine grey ash settled on the cooled rock

name: Verkohltes Holz
look: black burnt planks running in one direction, deep alligator cracking across the charcoal surface, grey ash caught in the grooves

name: Krypta-Stein
look: large dark grey stone slabs with chipped edges, a little green moss and pale lichen only in the narrow joints between them, damp water stains on the stone
